name: Piano Scales for Beginners
instructions: The C major scale uses only the white keys from C to the next C, and is the easiest scale to start with.
Learn proper finger numbering for the right hand: 1 (thumb) through 5 (pinky), with a thumb-tuck needed to keep the scale flowing smoothly.
Play the scale slowly, up and down, focusing on even timing between notes rather than speed.
Watch today's video for an easy beginner lesson on piano scales.
